text: June 6, 1944. Paratrooper Tom Rice jumped into Normandy in the dark. *A bullet hit his parachute.* He survived the war. 75 years later he went back to France, *at 97 years old,* and jumped again over Carentan, near where he landed in 1944. This time strapped to a partner, in daylight, with a crowd cheering below. He landed smiling: *"Perfect jump."* Hit like for the ones who came back.
title: The Paratrooper Jumped Again at 97 🪂💪
